Messages.Author: snegiem
Messages.Body:
Third eye
master discipline
if this card is on a vampire with superior obeah, this vampire gains one level of valeren.
if this card is is on vampire with superior valeren, this vampire gains one level of obeah.
if this card is on a salubri, this salubri gains another level of obeah.
if this card is on a salubri antitribe, this salubri antitribe gains one level of valeren.

Source: for all rulebooks of the rolepaying game, valeren and obeah had the first 2 levels similar.

Game interest: allowing to play salubri anti tribe and salubri together.

Messages.Author: Whisker
Messages.Body:
As there are no Salubri / !Salubri printed without at least one level of their signature discipline, the way this card is written, it will always end up giving them 1 level of both val and obe when played on members of those clans. Is this intentional? If so it's quite superior to any existing discipline cards and should perhaps induce a cost?

Also let's simplify the text a bit:
Opening the thrid eye
master, discipline
1 pool
Put this card on Salubri or Salubri Antitribu. The vampire with this card gain 1 level of obeah  and 1 level of valeren

Messages.Author: snegiem
Messages.Body:
you are right... it seems clearer that way...

as it is a discipline card, i wonder if it shall give a +1 capacity as well with a limitation such as a vampire can have only one open the third eye.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Opening the Fourth Eye
Requires a vampire with Opening the Third Eye
This vampire has superior Obeah, superior Valeren, gets +2 intercept and becomes a spider in addition to his or her other types.

Prince of Paris, France
